LanguageData.UNMS_NoSite: No suitable unreserved destination is available.
LanguageData.UNMS_NoEnemy: No suitable existing conflict is available.
LanguageData.UNMS_Enemy: Opposing faction: {0}; frozen combat budget: {1} points.
LanguageData.UNMS_Partial: Partial delivery saved. All requested goods are required before any reward is paid.
LanguageData.UNMS_EnemiesRemain: Defeat or incapacitate the camp guards before releasing the assigned prisoners.
LanguageData.UNMS_ReturnHome: These people are temporarily under player control. Bring them to the home map. Once stabilized, each stays as a guest for one game day and then leaves.
LanguageData.UNMS_Stale: The destination or exact target is no longer available. This offer cannot be accepted.
LanguageData.UNMS_UnsafeCleanup: Player units, prisoners, other active quest targets or native safety checks prevent removal. Abandoned loot and equipment are lost on closure.
LanguageData.UNMS_MoveMarker: Bring an able colonist within 8 cells of the handover marker.
LanguageData.UNMS_InvalidTarget: The exact target is unavailable; no duplicate has been created.
LanguageData.UNMS_Scope: Temporary sites and existing settlement deliveries are supported. Existing base assault/CBF and vehicle-framework integrations require separate compatibility tests.
LanguageData.UNMS_Claimed: This site or target is already assigned to another active offer.
LanguageData.UNMS_Goal0: Transport every listed item to this destination. At a settlement, select the caravan and deliver; at a camp, unload goods within 8 cells of the handover marker and review the objective. Multiple trips are allowed.
LanguageData.UNMS_Goal1: Heal every patient of acute injuries and curable infections/diseases. No room, temperature or bed requirements. Recovered field patients count at quest completion; patients transported home each stay as guests for one game day after full recovery, then depart safely. Both treatment routes may be combined.
LanguageData.UNMS_Goal2: Take temporary responsibility for every assigned civilian at the handover point. Bring them home alive, stop bleeding and wait for anesthesia to wear off. Each stays as a guest for one game day; all must depart safely.
LanguageData.UNMS_Goal3: Free every assigned prisoner after the guards are defeated or incapacitated. Bring them home alive and stabilize them. Each stays as a guest for one game day; all must depart safely.
LanguageData.UNMS_Goal4: Keep every assigned civilian and the marked handover point alive for the entire stated defense period, and neutralize every assigned attacker: incapacitated, captured or confirmed departed.
LanguageData.UNMS_Goal5: Protect all assigned civilians and the marked handover point through the defense period and repel every assigned attacker. The supported faction and UN provide local defenders.
LanguageData.UNMS_Goal6: Capture the exact named living faction leader, keep them alive, transport them home, stop bleeding and board the UN pickup shuttle. Killing the target fails the mission.
LanguageData.UNMS_BionicGoal: Special case: one patient needs the bionic arm or leg supplied at the site. Perform the normal surgery and wait for recovery and the anesthetic to wear off.
LanguageData.UNMS_ShuttleWaiting: UN pickup shuttle: eligible guests board; carry guests who cannot walk aboard if necessary.
LanguageData.UNMS_CleanupReady: Cleared operation site: will automatically disappear from the world map.
LanguageData.UNMS_CleanupWaiting: Operation ended. Removal waits for player units, prisoners, other active quest targets or native safety checks (e.g. incoming transports).
LanguageData.UNMS_GuestLeaving: Departing / waiting for a safe route
LanguageData.UNMS_GuestNoRecruit: {0} is a temporary UN mission guest and cannot be recruited.
LanguageData.UNMED_NextField: Fully treat the remaining field patients or transport them to the home map.
LanguageData.UNMED_NextTransport: Bring patients outside the field hospital to the home map. Complete any started home treatment there.
LanguageData.UNMED_NextHome: Fully treat the home-map patients before their guest stay begins.
LanguageData.UNMED_NextReview: Checking the recovery of remaining field patients.
LanguageData.UNMED_Summary: Field hospital recovered: {0}/{1} | Home treatment: {2}/{3} ({4} departed safely) | Elsewhere/in transit: {5}

LanguageData.UNMED_BionicFallback: The bionic case could not be prepared safely. A normal medical mission applies instead.
